description: ai-kit: skill check and CLAUDE.md budget

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; c="$root/.claude/skills/learn-skill/scripts/check-skill.sh"; [ -x "$c" ] || exit 0; "$c" check "$root/.claude/skills" --changed --agents "$root/.agents/skills" 2>/dev/null; "$c" budget "$root/CLAUDE.md" 150 2>/dev/null; true
